scope: Resume frozen 22 questions /24 source candidates on actual PDF96–99 including the original and altered figure illustrations. Fixed labels and contextual behaviour, correlational limits, multiple-view research question, and perception experiment procedures. Retain correctly supported questions, distinguish reported results from prompts and causal proof, and remove unshown prior-task and website implementation dependencies without altering source text or historical scores.
